name: Millhaven
source: Returning to Millhaven in search of a fresh start, the protagonist reconnects with his gentle childhood friend Yuki and meets the bold, outgoing Mia. Each day, he chooses where to work and spend his time, while relationships, rival suitors, and village events continue to develop—even when he is elsewhere.
